product.title: Yellowstone 2-Step 2 of Days Of Upper/Lower Loop West Yellowstone

description.text: Join a small group of up to fourteen for a two-day sweep of Yellowstone's upper and lower loops from West Yellowstone. The same route as the private version covers Lamar Valley wildlife, Mammoth Hot Springs terraces, Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic Spring, and canyon overlooks at a shared per-person rate.

highlights: Two-day small-group upper and lower loop tour
Maximum fourteen guests with professional guide
Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley wildlife stops
Old Faithful and Grand Prismatic Spring boardwalks
Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone rim viewpoints

start.description: Morning pickup from West Yellowstone hotels and the visitor center area. Confirm your pickup window when booking.

end.description: Return to West Yellowstone after the day-two lower loop and Old Faithful stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Join a small group of up to fourteen for a two-day sweep of Yellowstone's upper and lower loops from West Yellowstone.

itineraryItems.title: Lamar Valley
itineraryItems.description: Day one wildlife drive through Lamar Valley with stops for bison herds and predator habitat.

itineraryItems.title: Mammoth Hot Springs
itineraryItems.description: Walk the Mammoth Hot Springs travertine terraces and historic fort area.

itineraryItems.title: Old Faithful
itineraryItems.description: Day two geyser basin stop timed for an Old Faithful eruption.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Prismatic Spring
itineraryItems.description: Boardwalk visit to Grand Prismatic Spring in Midway Geyser Basin.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone
itineraryItems.description: Rim stop at Artist Point for views of the yellow canyon and Lower Falls.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
